facts.text: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines for construction, mining, quarrying and similar work already sells a system that warns the operator when the machine gets too close to an object.
facts.quote: A manufacturer of heavy off-road machines for construction, mining, quarrying and similar work already sells a system that warns the operator when the machine gets too close to an object.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine manufacturer is developing a system that applies the brakes automatically if the operator does not react to a proximity warning.
facts.quote: It is now developing a system that also applies the brakes automatically if the operator does not react.

facts.text: Prototype hardware and software for the heavy off-road machine automatic braking system will arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software will arrive in mid-2027

facts.text: Validation of the heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must finish in less than four months after prototype hardware and software arrive in mid-2027.
facts.quote: Prototype hardware and software will arrive in mid-2027, and validation must then finish in less than four months

facts.text: Past physical testing and tuning at the heavy off-road machine manufacturer took three to four years for each machine model.
facts.quote: in the past it took three to four years of physical testing and tuning for each machine model.

facts.text: The new heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work across more than 100 types of job site.
facts.quote: The new system must work across more than 100 types of job site

facts.text: The new heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work across more than 10 operating scenarios per machine.
facts.quote: more than 10 operating scenarios per machine

facts.text: The new heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work in many weather and light conditions, including rain, snow, fog, dust, dusk, darkness and glare.
facts.quote: many weather and light conditions (rain, snow, fog, dust, dusk, darkness, glare)

facts.text: The new heavy off-road machine automatic braking system must work across many machine models with different sizes and sensor positions.
facts.quote: many machine models with different sizes and sensor positions.

facts.text: The heavy off-road machine manufacturer has not previously used simulation for this kind of validation.
facts.quote: The organization has not used simulation for this kind of validation before.

facts.text: The simulation-credibility research was required to remain neutral across vendors, products and technologies and cover commercial, open-source, academic and in-house options.
facts.quote: The research was to stay neutral across vendors, products and technologies and to cover commercial, open-source, academic and in-house options.

facts.text: Each important claim in the simulation-credibility research had to be labeled by evidence type: independent study, standard or third-party test; the vendor's own claim; or expert opinion.
facts.quote: Each important claim was to be labeled by its type of evidence (independent study, standard or third-party test; the vendor's own claim; or expert opinion)

facts.text: Each source used in the simulation-credibility research had to be dated.
facts.quote: each source was to be dated.

facts.text: The simulation-credibility research had to report failures, limits and evidence against each approach, rather than reporting only successes.
facts.quote: Failures, limits and evidence against each approach were to be reported, not only successes.

facts.text: The simulation-credibility research had to flag findings proven only for on-road vehicles as on-road evidence.
facts.quote: Anything proven only for on-road vehicles had to be flagged as such

facts.text: When the simulation-credibility research could find no information, the answer had to be "not found" rather than a guessed number, price or timeline.
facts.quote: where nothing could be found the answer was to be "not found" rather than a guessed number, price or timeline.
